newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's TCV restructuring hot stocks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's TCV restructuring hot stocks.

text.p: Treasury Corp of Victoria said on Friday it is restructuring its outstanding "hot stocks" and would seek to establish a new benchmark 2008 line before the end of the year.

"The aim or the proposed restructure is to achieve a well balanced maturity profile of hot stocks out to the year 2008, whilst maintaining a level of hot stock outstandings consistent with TCV's long term view of 40-60 percent of debt requirements being provided by the market," said David Carruthers, TCV's Managing Director.

Under phase one of the restructure, holders of the 12.50 percent July 15, 2000 stock would be offered the opportunity to switch to other TCV stocks and this line would cease to exist by the end of September. This process would commence on Tuesday, September 17.
Following this consolidation, TCV will seek opportunities to establish a new benchmark line maturing August 15, 2008 with a semi annual coupon of 7.50 percent.
Depending on market conditions and the success of phase one, TCV anticipates issuing the new stock prior to the end of this calender year.

"TCV remains committed to the domestic bond market and this restructuring is aimed at keeping the focus of TCV's hots stocks as the benchmark funding in our liability base," said Michael Dontschuk, TCV's Executive General Manager.
